summary: Youxin Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a non-binding term sheet signed July 14, 2026 to acquire a 10% minority equity interest in RiverBit Holding Limited for up to $20 million, based on a pre-agreed valuation of $200 million. Consideration may be in the form of Class A ordinary shares, cash, or both. The strategic investment is contingent on RiverBit achieving milestones of 2,000 daily users and $100 million daily trading volume within three months post-launch. No board recommendation or advisor named. Definitive agreements, due diligence, board and shareholder approvals required. No break fee. Watch for execution risk on milestones and final deal terms.
